item.title: 25cm+ raised pavement due to tree roots, 18th October
item.description:

An ambulance was called and she was subsequently taken to A&E by a friend. This trip hazard has been getting worse as the tree on the grass verge grows and the roots push up the tarmac paving. A number of people including myself have also tripped on this.
